description: One product in one tank, at its own rate per acre. A tank mix is several of these and each carries its own rate, its own label interval and — where the machine flips between two sets mid-pass — its own nozzle set. The label numbers are COPIED here at mix time rather than fetched on every read, because a mix filed in April and read in a hearing in November has to say what the label said in April.

fields.description: The product's name as the register spelled it when the mix was written. Stored rather than fetched so a mix read years later names what actually went in the tank.
fields.label: Product Name

fields.description: How much of THIS product goes on one acre. Per product rather than per tank: a tank mix is several rates that happen to share a tank, and a single tank figure cannot be checked against a label.
fields.label: Rate / Acre

fields.description: Which nozzle set carries this product on a dual-set machine. 'A' and 'B' are the two sets that get flipped mid-pass — a fungicide through the upper tower and an insecticide through the lower, or a band herbicide flipped in at the headland. 'Both' means it goes out through whichever set is running, which is what a single-set machine always means.
fields.label: Nozzle Set

fields.description: Restricted-entry interval off this product's own Item record, copied at mix time. The LONGEST of these in the tank is what closes the block — see the Spray Tank Mix description.
fields.label: REI Hours

fields.description: Pre-harvest interval in days, copied the same way.
fields.label: PHI Days

fields.description: EPA registration number, copied off the Item where the register carries one. It is what a state inspector asks for by number rather than by name.
fields.label: EPA Reg. Number

fields.description: What this product is in the tank for — 'codling moth', 'powdery mildew', 'suppression only'. A mix with a product nobody can say the purpose of is a mix somebody added out of habit.
fields.label: Target

name: Spray Tank Mix Product
